notes.title: Thanks for your support!
notes.notes:
Sales reached 2000+... For a small producer like me who has no fans, I am really satisfied.
Thank you for your purchase and support. Your support allows me to continue to do it... Thank you very much!

I have many shortcomings, pictures, music, plot, I will gradually improve.
At the same time, thank you all for your encouragement... I will work harder! Thank you for your support, thank you.
